content: Dependency policy: run 'npm audit --audit-level=high --omit=dev' in CI so prod deps gate merges and dev-tool CVEs do not. Audit after 'npm ci' (same tree as CI), not npm install. Avoid blanket 'npm audit fix' - it churns the lockfile and causes regressions. Triage by direct vs transitive and by reachability from app entry points (Snyk/osv-scanner reachability); document accepted risks with expiry.
